Duvets listing with filters Category, Tog Rating, Filling, Size; quick links Feather, Synthetic, Hypoallergenic; size and tog as filters
Rugs and home textiles: bedding, decorative pillows and cushion covers, rugs, table linens, blankets and throws, bathroom textiles, towels, curtains, kitchen towels, door mats
Heimtextilien umbrella: Teppiche, Matratzen, Bettwaesche, Kissen, Gardinen und Vorhaenge, Wohn- und Tagesdecken, Tapeten, Handtuecher; buying guide text separates functional from decorative textiles
Persian rug type names (Tabriz, Kashan, Heriz, Qashqai) are city, region, village-trade or tribal labels that overlap; three families not a quality hierarchy; pile vs flatweave cuts across geography
Flatweave is an umbrella; kilim (weft-faced tapestry), dhurrie (South Asian regional/trade category), soumak (weft wrapping) overlap and are not strict construction specs
Persian carpet types split into Nomadic/Tribal, Village, Traditional (city); named types Tabriz, Kerman, Qum, Hamadan, Malayer, Kilim, Bokhara; Hamadan stated as collective name for rugs of a region
Kilim = flatweave used interchangeably; handwoven vs hand-knotted; shop navigation by Type (vintage, overdyed, patchwork, runner, new kilim, hand-knotted), Style, Size, Age, Color
ISO 2424:2024 Textile floor coverings vocabulary: defines terms and categories of textile floor coverings (ISO/TC 219 floor coverings); detail text not freely shown

EN 1307 classifies textile floor coverings and carpet tiles (excluding rugs and runners, which fall under ISO 2424) into use classes for wear, appearance retention, additional performance and luxury rating; needled types A1-A3, B1-B3; refers to EN ISO 10874 room-use classes

ASTM Home Furnishings family: bedspreads, comforters, curtain and drapery fabrics, soft window coverings, towel products, shower curtains, sheeting products; separate Pile Floor Coverings family; D3775 end and pick count; D4522 feather and down fillings

Thread count is a North American marketing term of art for woven bedlinen, count of warp plus weft threads per square inch; ply-counting inflation, FTC 2005 letter and 2017 exclusion order; industry says beyond about 400 no quality difference

Fill power is loft of down in cubic inches per ounce (about 300 for feathers to 900 for best goose down), measured by IDFB 30 g cylinder test; used for duvets, comforters, sleeping bags; the most used down quality measure

Nitori rugs under Carpets-rugs-mats: guide types plain, patterned, dining, quilted, round, rug pads, shaggy; filters colour, price, size in tatami (jo), function (non-slip, heated-floor compatible, anti-mite, washable, cooling), material; brand facet Nitori vs Deco Home

Rakuten Ichiba bedding genre (Interior/Bedding/Storage > Bedding) with futon-set sub-genre (kake-shiki futon sets, single/semi-double/double/queen sizes); futon items sold as sets with pillows and covers

Rugs and carpets facets: item type (new/made to order, antique and vintage, pre-owned), style (Art Nouveau, Baroque...), period, material, place of origin; listing categories read as period + origin + named type (Aubusson, Oushak, Heriz Serapi, Kashan, Savonnerie, Tabriz); named types are place or workshop labels
Rugs collection shop by style and brand; named styles Beni Ourain, jute, hide, rag rugs, Turkish kilims, Moroccan Berber; colour and size filters

Antique hand-woven rugs and carpets 15th to early 20th century from Silk Road countries and Europe; sold within Islamic and Indian Worlds sale; examples Safavid carpet and prayer rug; treated as a collector department

Curtains split by heading (eyelet, pencil pleat), lining (blackout, thermal, lined, unlined), voile and net; blinds by type (roller, venetian, roman, vertical); poles, tracks, rings are separate accessory category

Blind styles panel, pleated, roller, roman, venetian, vertical, wooden; shades (single soft material) vs slatted blinds; term window blinds used broadly for all coverings; materials fabric, wood, metal; cordless safety
Blind types Rollo, Raffrollo, Jalousie, Plissee distinguished by mechanism first (light control, stack height); curtains decided by fabric and heading
Window coverings: roller (blockout, sunscreen, light-filter fabrics), roman, venetian, vertical, curtains with S-fold heading, double roller, plantation shutters; chosen by room and job first

Sheets buying guide: weave (percale vs sateen), thread count (claimed 152-680, over 400 usually finer yarn, not a quality guarantee), cotton staple class (short, long, extra-long; Pima, Egyptian, Supima trademark); tested on fit, softness, shrinkage; brand list (Brooklinen, Matouk, L.L.Bean, Parachute)
Quilt (stitched layers), comforter (cover built in, filled), duvet (insert used with separate cover); distinction by construction and warmth/loft; fills down, down alternative, wool, cotton
Wirecutter sheets guide organises cotton sheets by weave percale vs sateen (and linen); picks named product models (e.g. L.L.Bean 280 TC Pima percale)

Museum describes carpets by court/region (Ushak, Anhalt Medallion, Vase, Polonaise, Pashmina), knot type (symmetric/asymmetric knotted pile), tapestry-woven; kilims (flat-weaves) as separate family; regional stylistic traits
Knot density (kpsi) is the traditional quality measure of knotted-pile carpets: <=80 poor, 120-330 medium to good, >=330 very good; only one measure of quality, varies by region and design
Rug construction types: hand-knotted, hand-tufted, hand-loomed/flatweave (kilim, dhurrie, tapestry), machine-made broadloom, Axminster, Wilton, hand-hooked

Seven bath towel types: bath towel, bath sheet, hand towel, face towel, Turkish towel (peshtemal), waffle weave, terry cloth; GSM bands (300-400 travel, 400-500 everyday, 500-600 quality, 600+ luxury); Turkish and Egyptian cotton as grades; size table

Towel shop navigation by size (bath sheet, bath towel, hand towel, washcloth, bath mat, 6-piece set), then weight bands (midweight, lightweight) and named lines (Lexi, Essence, Kind Earth); peshtemal as a separate flat-woven category

HS 2022 chapter 57: 5701 knotted, 5702 woven not tufted (incl. Kelem, Schumacks, Karamanie and similar hand-woven rugs; coir; pile vs non-pile), 5703 tufted (incl. turf), 5704 felt, 5705 other; divided by construction first then fibre; underlays excluded

HTS chapter 63 made-up textile articles: 6301 blankets and travelling rugs (incl. electric blankets), 6304 other furnishing articles incl. wall hangings; Note 3 groups bed linen, table linen, toilet linen and kitchen linen as one family

UNSPSC family 5212 Bedclothes and table and kitchen linen and towels; class 52121500 Bedclothes lists quilts, comforters, comforter covers, mattress covers, pillows, mattress pads, featherbeds, blankets, sheets, dust ruffles, duvets, pillow cases, bed spreads, duvet cover

Textil hogar tree: Ropa de cama (fundas nordicas, sabanas, colchas, edredones, mantas, cuadrantes, fundas de almohada), Textil bano (toallas, albornoces, toallas de playa), Textil decoracion (alfombras, cojines, cortinas, estores, fundas de sofa); mattresses and pillows under Descanso

Persian carpets classified by weavers' social context (nomadic/tribal, village, town, court); village carpets carry the market-centre name as label and Serapi names a quality; Gelim covers pile rugs and flatweaves; size/format names (ghali, dozar, kelleghi, kenareh)

Duvet decision order: tog (thermal overall grade, warmth not weight), then filling type (synthetic microfibre, feather and down, cotton, silk, wool); pillow filling and firmness; dual-tog duvets; branded guarantees by fill
